templates.template-shell.name: Shell
templates.template-shell.summary: A host for your web app, with routing and navigation.
templates.template-shell.files.frontx-te: The manifest: the template's identity, version and the paths it owns.
templates.template-shell.files.src-app/a: The entry: registers the GTS schemas, builds the FrontX app with the microfrontends plugin, registers the themes and renders the layout.
Registers the screen, sidebar, popup and overlay domains and every MFE package the build found.
templates.template-shell.files.src/gts/s: The screen extension type: a route token and the presentation the menu is built from.
templates.template-shell.files.scripts/d: npm run dev:all: builds the MFE packages, serves each remote and starts the host.
templates.template-shell.files.vite.conf: The host build: Module Federation host with React and the query client as singletons.
templates.template-mfe.name: MFE workspace
templates.template-mfe.summary: Add screens that run inside the host.
templates.template-mfe.gives.3: A foundation for multiple UI units
templates.template-mfe.files.frontx-temp: The manifest: the paths the workspace owns, the blank package and the examples among them.
templates.template-mfe.files.src-app/mfe: The blank package's manifest: its remote entry, its entry and its screen extension with route and menu entry.
The lifecycle the host calls: mounts the React tree into the screen's shadow root with the kit's styles.
The screen: kit components, the shared theme and language, per-screen translations and an API query.
The package's API service: a REST protocol with a mock plugin that answers until a backend exists.
The remote build: Module Federation with the shared packages left external for the host to link.
templates.template-design-guardrails.sum: Design rules, agent guidance and interface checks for an existing project.
templates.template-design-guardrails.fil: The manifest: the design entry point, the verification package and the AI bundle it owns.
The short, human-readable entry point to the design rules.
The verification package: the design-defect checker, the accessibility suite and their dependencies.
The AI bundle: skills, standards, quality gates and review workflows for coding agents.
templates.template-site.name: Site sections
templates.template-site.summary: This site's home, templates, docs and Libraries screens with their content model.
templates.template-site.gives.1: The home, templates, docs and Libraries screens of this site.
templates.template-site.gives.2: A content model whose pages render in the screen and publish as plain text for coding agents.
templates.template-site.gives.3: Template pages built from each template's manifest at the version the site uses.
templates.template-site.files.frontx-tem: The manifest: the four screen packages and the shared content folder.
templates.template-site.files.src-app/mf: The home screen's manifest, with its page metadata.
The docs pages as an outline: steps, commands, expected results and limits.
The content model the outlines follow, with its parser.
templates.template-catalogue.name: UI kit catalogue
templates.template-catalogue.summary: Every @gears-frontx/ui-kit component as a page, grouped by family.
templates.template-catalogue.gives.1: A page per ui-kit component with its live example and the example's source.
templates.template-catalogue.gives.2: The install command and import lines for the kit version the site uses.
templates.template-catalogue.gives.3: Token foundations: semantic colors, typography, layout and elevation.
templates.template-catalogue.files.front: The manifest: the catalogue package it owns.
templates.template-catalogue.files.src-a: The catalogue's manifest, with page metadata for every component and foundation.
The page list: components from the kit's example files, their families and the foundations.
The routes: the index, a route per component and per foundation, and a not-found page.
templates.template-inbox.name: Inbox
templates.template-inbox.summary: A workspace product of four screens: contacts, dashboard, chat and mail.
templates.template-inbox.gives.1: Four screens of a workspace product: contacts, dashboard, chat and mail.
templates.template-inbox.gives.2: Mocked @gears-frontx/api services shared by the four screens.
templates.template-inbox.gives.3: Navigation from one screen to another, such as from a chat to the contact's page.
templates.template-inbox.files.frontx-te: The manifest: the four screen packages and their shared folder.
templates.template-inbox.files.src-app/m: The contacts screen's manifest, with a pattern route per person.
The API service the screens share, answered by its mock plugin.
Opens another inbox screen at a route inside it.
templates.template-mfe-demo.name: MFE mechanics demo
templates.template-mfe-demo.summary: Screens and widgets that show the bridge, actions and nested extension domains.
templates.template-mfe-demo.gives.1: Five screens of one package that show the bridge, shared properties and actions.
templates.template-mfe-demo.gives.2: A nested widgets screen that owns an extension domain of its own.
templates.template-mfe-demo.gives.3: Two widget packages mounted into that domain.
templates.template-mfe-demo.files.frontx: The manifest: the demo package and the two widget packages.
templates.template-mfe-demo.files.src-ap: Five entries and five screen extensions in one package.
The nested widgets screen: registers its own extension domain and mounts the widgets into it.
A widget package's manifest: extensions of the nested widgets screen's domain, not screens.
templates.template-calendar-demo.name: Calendar demo
templates.template-calendar-demo.summary: A calendar screen that is coming soon: a placeholder page for now.
templates.template-calendar-demo.gives.1: A calendar screen in the shell's menu, with one page that says it is coming soon.
templates.template-calendar-demo.gives.2: The page is built from @gears-frontx/ui-kit components, with a not-found page beside it.
templates.template-calendar-demo.files.f: The manifest: the calendar demo package it owns.
templates.template-calendar-demo.files.s: The screen's manifest: its entry and its screen extension with route and menu entry.
The routes: the placeholder page and a not-found page.
The placeholder page and the not-found page, built from the kit's Empty component.
requires.shell-and-kit-candidates-withou: A project with template-shell and template-kit-candidates applied. It cannot be applied next to template-mfe 0.1.0-alpha.2, which claims the same packages.
templates.template-mfe.exampleLead: Screens of this site built from this template's examples (through template-mfe-demo).
source.label: Source
groups.start.label: Shell + MFE workspace
templates.template-shell.lead: A host application that routes and mounts microfrontends, with its own build and development tooling.
templates.template-mfe.lead: Add a workspace for UI units, with host communication and an independent build. Apply it once, then create units inside it.
templates.template-design-guardrails.lea: Add design rules, agent guidance and interface checks to an existing project. This template adds no runtime screen.
templates.template-site.lead: This site's home, templates, docs and Libraries screens, with the content model their pages and plain-text twins are rendered from.
templates.template-site-meta.name: Site metadata
templates.template-site-meta.summary: The SEO pipeline: head tags, sitemap, robots, llms.txt and plain-text twins from the screens' seo blocks.
templates.template-site-meta.gives.1: A generator that writes the head, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, the web manifest and a plain-text twin of every outline page into the build.
templates.template-site-meta.gives.2: A check that holds the metadata rules and fails when a generated file drifts from its sources.
templates.template-site-meta.gives.3: head-sync, which keeps the document head equal to the page the address shows.
templates.template-site-meta.lead: Page metadata for a FrontX site from one source: each screen's seo block and a site config. The template adds a tooling package and no screen.
templates.template-site-meta.files.front: The manifest: the tooling package and the AI bundle it owns.
templates.template-site-meta.files.src-a: The package: its commands and the routing version head-sync bundles.
The command line: generate or check, the project, the site config and the raster record.
templates.template-site-meta.files..fron: The guideline: what the package generates, how to configure it and what never to edit by hand.
templates.template-site-brand.name: Site brand
templates.template-site-brand.summary: The brand on top of the UI kit: token values from one record, the typeface and a check that holds them.
templates.template-site-brand.gives.1: A brand record with the value, the design reference and the reason of every token, and the stylesheet and theme variables generated from it.
templates.template-site-brand.gives.2: The self-hosted Inter typeface and a document entry the shell loads once, so the shell and every screen render in the brand.
templates.template-site-brand.gives.3: A check that fails when a generated file drifts, a text pair falls under 4.5:1 or a brand value is declared outside the record.
templates.template-site-brand.lead: A brand for a FrontX site as one package on top of @gears-frontx/ui-kit. The template adds a package the shell loads into the document and no screen.
templates.template-site-brand.files.fron: The manifest: the brand package and the AI bundle it owns.
templates.template-site-brand.files.src-: The package: the stylesheets, theme variables and assets it exports, and the typeface it installs.
The document entry: brand tokens, the typeface and the page column, in that order.
templates.template-site-brand.files..fro: The guideline: where each value lives, how to add one and the rules the check holds.
templates.template-kit-candidates.name: Kit candidates
templates.template-kit-candidates.summar: Components proposed to the UI kit, in its own layout and API, used here until the kit releases them.
Heading, Text, Link, VisuallyHidden and the sr-only utility on the kit's type ramp.
CodeBlock with a copy button, DescriptionList, and render on Card, CardTitle, EmptyTitle and AlertTitle.
Tests with accessibility checks for every component, so the move to the kit is an import change.
templates.template-kit-candidates.lead: Primitives the UI kit does not have yet, as one package with the kit's folder layout and the API proposed to it. The template adds a package and no screen, and is deleted when the kit ships them.
The manifest: the component package and the AI bundle it owns.
The package: its exports and the kit version its components build on.
The public surface: every component and recipe the package exports.
The guideline: what is here, how to use it and the step that removes it.
templates.template-site-blocks.name: Site blocks
templates.template-site-blocks.summary: The site's sections as blocks: kit components arranged on layout tokens, with content-only props.
templates.template-site-blocks.gives.1: One block per arrangement the site draws, built only from kit components, kit candidates, brand art and layout tokens.
templates.template-site-blocks.gives.2: Layout-only styles and content-only props, with a card, a fixture and an accessibility test for every block.
templates.template-site-blocks.gives.3: A showcase screen that renders every block's fixture on its own route, kept out of the search index.
templates.template-site-blocks.lead: The site's blocks as one package on top of @gears-frontx/ui-kit and the kit candidates. The template adds a package the screens import by block, its layout tokens and a showcase screen.
templates.template-site-blocks.files.fro: The manifest: the blocks package, the showcase screen and the AI bundle it owns.
templates.template-site-blocks.files.src: The package: one entry point per block, the layout tokens and the kit versions the blocks build on.
The layout tokens the blocks share: the page column, the header height, the section and intro rhythm and the lead and rail columns.
templates.template-site-blocks.files..fr: The guideline: what a block may contain, its props and styles, and how to add one.
templates.template-catalogue.lead: Every @gears-frontx/ui-kit component as a page with a live example and its source, grouped by family, with the kit's token foundations.
templates.template-inbox.lead: A workspace product of four screens, contacts, dashboard, chat and mail, on mocked API services they share.
templates.template-mfe-demo.lead: Screens and widgets that show the bridge, shared properties, actions and an extension domain nested inside a screen.
templates.template-calendar-demo.lead: A calendar screen that is coming soon: one placeholder page built from ui-kit components.
